data.title: Kuala Lumpur Twin Towers, Batu Caves & Urban Luxury
data.description: Stay in the heart of Bukit Bintang & KLCC. Includes skip-the-line Petronas Twin Towers Skybridge & 86th Floor tickets, Batu Caves & Royal Selangor heritage tour, KL Tower Atmosphere 360 revolving high-tea, and private airport transfers.
data.instructions: Includes 4-star/5-star KLCC hotel stay, guaranteed Twin Towers slot, private chauffeur-guide, and KLIA Ekspres or private car return transfer.
data.childPolicy: Children under 90cm enter attractions free. Ages 3–12 qualify for child package rate.
data.termsAndConditions: Twin Towers observation slots are subject to government quota and guaranteed upon booking. Free cancellation up to 72 hours before check-in.
data.importantInfo: Includes private KLIA airport roundtrip transfers, 4-star KLCC hotel, guaranteed Twin Towers 86th-floor entry, and Batu Caves private tour.

itinerary.title: KLIA Private Arrival & Bukit Bintang Check-in
itinerary.activities: Private air-conditioned chauffeur pickup from KLIA/KLIA2 directly to your luxury hotel. Evening stroll through Jalan Alor foodie haven.

itinerary.title: Petronas Twin Towers & KL City Heritage Tour
itinerary.activities: Morning skip-the-line pass to Petronas Twin Towers Level 86 Observation Deck, King's Palace (Istana Negara), National Mosque, and Merdeka 118 viewpoint.

itinerary.title: Batu Caves 272 Rainbow Steps & KL Tower High-Tea
itinerary.activities: Visit iconic Lord Murugan statue and limestone cathedral caves, Royal Selangor pewter crafting, followed by high-tea at KL Tower revolving lounge.

itinerary.title: Pavilion Luxury Shopping & KLIA Chauffeur Transfer
itinerary.activities: Morning leisure for shopping in Bukit Bintang, followed by timely private hotel checkout and transfer to KLIA.

data.title: Semporna, Bohey Dulang & Mabul Water Bungalow Dive Paradise
data.description: Sail across the world's most biodiverse coral triangle in Semporna. Hike Bohey Dulang viewpoint, snorkel pristine Sibuan & Mataking coral reefs, and stay in luxury water bungalows over translucent turquoise lagoons.
data.instructions: Includes Tawau Airport (TWU) return transfers, speedboat island hopping permits, snorkeling gear, underwater photography by boat crew, and full-board meals.
data.timings: Daily Departures from Tawau / Semporna Jetty
data.childPolicy: Life vests provided in all child sizes. Suitable for all ages.
data.termsAndConditions: Island hopping permits registered in advance with Sabah Parks. Subject to weather & marine conditions. Free reschedule in case of extreme weather.
data.importantInfo: Overwater bungalow accommodation, private island speedboats, full-board gourmet meals, and professional underwater Go-Pro photographer included.

itinerary.title: Tawau Airport Pickup & Semporna Jetty Check-in
itinerary.activities: Private airport pickup from TWU, transfer to Semporna marina, speedboat to luxury overwater chalet, and sunset welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Bohey Dulang Volcano Hike & Sibuan Island
itinerary.activities: Hike 600m to the spectacular panoramic volcanic caldera viewpoint over Tun Sakaran Marine Park, followed by swimming with sea turtles at Sibuan.

itinerary.title: Mataking Island Sandbar & Timba-Timba Snorkeling
itinerary.activities: Explore the natural sandbar connecting Mataking islands, snorkel over coral gardens with clownfish, and underwater photography sessions.

itinerary.title: Mabul & Kapalai Overwater Coral Reefs
itinerary.activities: Full day snorkeling and relaxing around Mabul water village, shallow coral shelves, and encounters with manta rays and green turtles.

itinerary.title: Lagoon Sunrise & Airport Departure
itinerary.activities: Sunrise breakfast over the turquoise ocean deck, speedboat return to Semporna, and private transfer back to Tawau Airport.

data.title: Genting Highlands SkyWorlds Theme Park & Cloud Resort Escape
data.description: Experience Malaysia's premier entertainment resort above the clouds with Genting SkyWorlds outdoor theme park passes, Skytropolis Indoor Park, Awana SkyWay glass-floor cable car, Chin Swee Caves Temple, and Genting Premium Outlets.
data.instructions: Includes Genting SkyWorlds 1-Day Unlimited Pass with Virtual Queue access, Awana SkyWay return cable car, and resort accommodation.
data.childPolicy: Children under 90cm free. Child tickets apply for height 90cm–110cm.
data.termsAndConditions: Theme park passes include 6 complimentary Virtual Queue (VQ) reservations. Rides subject to park operating hours and weather safety.
data.importantInfo: Includes 1-day unlimited Genting SkyWorlds entry, Awana SkyWay glass-bottom gondola, and mountain resort stay.

itinerary.title: KL to Genting Cable Car & Cloud Check-in
itinerary.activities: Private transfer from KL to Awana SkyWay station, scenic glass-floor gondola ride over ancient rainforests, and check-in to Resorts World Genting.

itinerary.title: Full Day Genting SkyWorlds 9 Themed Worlds
itinerary.activities: Unlimited thrill rides across Eagle Mountain, Central Park, Ice Age, Rio, and Andromeda Base with Virtual Queue fast access.

itinerary.title: Chin Swee Caves Temple & Premium Outlets
itinerary.activities: Visit the 9-storey pagoda at Chin Swee Temple with sweeping valley views, duty-free designer shopping at Genting Premium Outlets, and return transfer.

data.title: Sabah Borneo Rainforest, Kinabalu & Wildlife Expedition
data.description: Trek through ancient Bornean rainforests, explore Mount Kinabalu UNESCO National Park, soak in Poring Hot Springs, and cruise the Kinabatangan River to spot wild orangutans, proboscis monkeys, and pygmy elephants.
data.instructions: All land transfers, Sabah Parks conservation permits, licensed naturalist guides, rainforest eco-lodge stays, and full-board meals are included.
data.childPolicy: Suitable for children aged 5 and above. Child rate applies for ages 5–11.
data.termsAndConditions: Sabah wildlife park conservation permits are non-refundable once registered with Sabah Wildlife Department. Moderate walking fitness recommended.
data.importantInfo: Includes Sabah Parks entrance permits, certified naturalist wildlife guide, Kinabatangan River riverboat safaris, and rainforest eco-lodge stays.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kota Kinabalu & Waterfront Market
itinerary.activities: Arrive at BKI Airport, check into 5-star seafront hotel, and evening guided walk through Filipino Handicraft Market and fresh seafood dining.

itinerary.title: Mount Kinabalu National Park & Canopy Walk
itinerary.activities: Scenic mountain drive to Kinabalu UNESCO World Heritage Park, botanical garden nature trek, Poring Hot Springs sulfur dip, and treetop canopy walkway.

itinerary.title: Fly to Sandakan & Sepilok Orangutan Sanctuary
itinerary.activities: Short morning flight to Sandakan, visit Sepilok Orangutan Rehabilitation Centre feeding platform, and Sun Bear Conservation Centre.

itinerary.title: Kinabatangan River Sunset Wildlife Cruise
itinerary.activities: Journey into Sukau Rainforest Eco-Lodge, afternoon river boat safari spotting wild proboscis monkeys, hornbills, and Bornean pygmy elephants.

itinerary.title: Oxbow Lake Dawn Birding & Gomantong Caves
itinerary.activities: Early 06:00 AM dawn river cruise on Kelenanap Oxbow Lake for exotic bird watching, followed by visit to ancient swiftlet limestone Gomantong Caves.

itinerary.title: Sandakan City Highlights & Departure
itinerary.activities: Visit Agnes Keith Colonial House and Puu Jih Shih Buddhist Temple before airport transfer for onward flight.

data.title: Historic Melaka Straits River Cruise & Nyonya Cultural Day Experience
data.description: Full-day private cultural excursion from Kuala Lumpur to historic Melaka. Visit Dutch Square (Stadthuys), St. Paul's Hill, A Famosa fortress, Jonker Street, enjoy a Melaka River boat cruise, and savor authentic Nyonya Peranakan lunch.
data.instructions: Includes hotel pick-up and drop-off in Kuala Lumpur, Melaka River Cruise ticket, Nyonya lunch set, and English-speaking heritage driver-guide.
data.childPolicy: Children aged 3–11 at RM 210.
data.termsAndConditions: Door-to-door hotel pickup included. 100% refund for cancellations made at least 24 hours prior to departure.
data.importantInfo: Includes private driver-guide, Dutch Square admission, Melaka River boat cruise pass, and 6-course Nyonya Peranakan feast.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Historic Melaka Discovery
itinerary.activities: 08:30 AM pickup from KL hotel. Explore 16th-century A Famosa Portuguese fortress, St. Paul’s Church on the hill, red brick Stadthuys, scenic 45-min Melaka River boat cruise, traditional Peranakan banquet lunch, and afternoon shopping for antiques & gula melaka on Jonker Street before 06:30 PM return to KL.

data.title: Cameron Highlands Mossy Forest & Boh Tea Sanctuary
data.description: Escape the tropical heat at 1,500m elevation among emerald BOH tea plantations, misty ancient Mossy Forest boardwalks, organic strawberry farms, and colonial English heritage cottages.
data.instructions: Private 4x4 Land Rover excursion into Mossy Forest, boutique highland resort stay, steamboat dinner, and private return transfer from Kuala Lumpur or Penang.
data.childPolicy: Family-friendly itinerary. Child discount available for ages 3–11.
data.termsAndConditions: Mossy Forest boardwalk is operated under Pahang Forestry Department permits (included). Warm clothing recommended for 15-20°C temperatures.
data.importantInfo: Includes private Land Rover 4x4, tea factory guided tour, boutique Tudor-style resort, and traditional fresh highland steamboat feast.

itinerary.title: Scenic Mountain Drive & Lata Iskandar Waterfall
itinerary.activities: Private morning pickup from Kuala Lumpur/Penang, scenic winding drive via Lata Iskandar jungle cascade, and check-in to your highland resort.

itinerary.title: BOH Sungei Palas Tea Centre & Ancient Mossy Forest
itinerary.activities: Early morning 4x4 Land Rover ascent to Mount Brinchang, elevated boardwalk walk through prehistoric Jurassic Mossy Forest, and artisanal tea tasting.

itinerary.title: Raju Hill Strawberry Picking & Return Transfer
itinerary.activities: Pick fresh highland strawberries, browse Kea Farm local farmers market for honey and lavender, and relaxed scenic drive back to KL/Penang.

data.title: Penang UNESCO George Town Heritage, Hill & Michelin Hawker Trail
data.description: Discover the cultural soul of Malaysia across George Town's UNESCO streets, Pinang Peranakan Mansion, Kek Lok Si Temple, Clan Jetties, The Habitat Penang Hill canopy walk, and curated Michelin Bib Gourmand street food tastings.
data.instructions: Includes boutique heritage Mansion stay, Fast-Lane Penang Hill funicular pass, guided trishaw ride, and private culinary guide.
data.childPolicy: Children aged 3–11 receive 30% discount.
data.termsAndConditions: Trishaw rides and street food tastings included. Free cancellation up to 5 days prior to arrival.
data.importantInfo: Includes boutique Peranakan mansion stay, VIP Fast-Lane Penang Hill funicular railway, and curated Michelin street food safari.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Pearl of the Orient & Trishaw Heritage Ride
itinerary.activities: Private Penang Airport (PEN) transfer to George Town, nostalgic bicycle trishaw ride through Armenian Street mural alleys, and Chew Clan Jetty on stilts.

itinerary.title: Kek Lok Si Temple & The Habitat Penang Hill Rainforest
itinerary.activities: Ascend Penang Hill via VIP fast-track funicular train to Curtis Crest Tree Top Walk, followed by Southeast Asia’s largest Buddhist temple Kek Lok Si.

itinerary.title: Michelin Street Food Trail & Peranakan Mansion
itinerary.activities: Guided walking tasting of Penang Char Kway Teow, Assam Laksa, and Chendol, followed by private tour of opulent 19th-century Pinang Peranakan Mansion.

itinerary.title: Batu Ferringhi Coastline & Airport Transfer
itinerary.activities: Scenic coastal drive, visit Tropical Spice Garden, and comfortable private chauffeur transfer back to Penang International Airport.

data.title: Langkawi Luxury Overwater & Island Hopping Escape
data.description: Experience Malaysia's premier Andaman island paradise with overwater villa stays, private sunset catamaran dining, Langkawi SkyCab & SkyBridge fast-track passes, and Kilim Geoforest mangrove eco-safari.
data.instructions: Includes twin-sharing overwater accommodation, daily gourmet breakfast, private return airport transfers from LGK, and sunset yacht dinner cruise.
data.childPolicy: Children aged 3–11 enjoy 35% off adult twin-share rate. Infants under 2 travel free.
data.termsAndConditions: Free cancellation up to 7 days prior to departure. 50% deposit required to confirm. All ferry and speed boat transfers are subject to marine weather safety regulations.
data.importantInfo: Includes private LGK airport transfers, daily breakfast buffet, sunset catamaran cruise dinner, and SkyCab VIP express passes.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Langkawi & Sunset Yacht Cruise
itinerary.activities: VIP meet and greet at Langkawi International Airport, private transfer to your overwater villa, and evening Andaman Sea sunset dinner cruise with saltwater jacuzzi net.

itinerary.title: Kilim Karst Geoforest Park & Eagle Watching
itinerary.activities: Morning private boat safari through ancient limestone caves, mangrove forests, eagle feeding cove, crocodile cave, and secluded Tanjung Rhu beach.

itinerary.title: Langkawi SkyCab, SkyBridge & 3D Art Museum
itinerary.activities: Express lane access to the steepest cable car on Gunung Mat Cincang, panoramic walk across the iconic curved SkyBridge, and Oriental Village 3D art experience.

itinerary.title: Island Hopping: Dayang Bunting & Beras Basah
itinerary.activities: Private speed boat excursion to the Lake of the Pregnant Maiden (Dayang Bunting), crystal white sands of Beras Basah Island, and coral snorkeling.

itinerary.title: Duty-Free Shopping & Departure Transfer
itinerary.activities: Morning free leisure in Kuah Town for duty-free chocolates & perfumes, followed by private chauffeur transfer to Langkawi Airport.
